title: File:Chiang Mai sunday evening walking street.jpg
author: Takeaway
description: The Sunday evening walking street is a market which is held in Chiang Mai on Rachadamnoen road, the main road through the old city which leads from Tapae gate to Wat Phra Singh, and its side streets. The products on sale are mainly handicrafts which are made in and around Chiang Mai. Most of the food stalls can be found on adjacent temple grounds.
